title: Business assignments backend (assignable roles, accountable owner)
objective: Each tenant configures which roles are assignable to leads and quotes and which lead role is the accountable owner, driving the multi-role assignment model (spec FR-23, FR-35, PRD 8/10.4).
scope: Query service exposing assignable roles + eligible users per role for pickers
implementation_details: Liquibase 060-assignments: business_assignments (tenant_id, id identity, role_id bigint FK roles, applies_to text check in ('lead','quote'), is_accountable_owner bool default false, display_order int, PK (tenant_id,id), unique (tenant_id, role_id, applies_to))

Features/BusinessAssignments: GetBusinessAssignmentsQuery -> {leadRoles:[{assignmentId, roleId, roleName, isAccountableOwner}], quoteRoles:[...]}; UpdateBusinessAssignmentsCommand replacing the configuration transactionally with validation: exactly one is_accountable_owner among lead roles; role_id must reference an active tenant (or global) role; cannot remove a role config while live leads/quotes hold an assignee for it (409 ASSIGNMENT_ROLE_IN_USE — check deferred-safe: lead_assignments/quote_assignments existence, tables from T-018/T-020, guarded with to-table-existence check until then)

Features/BusinessAssignments/GetEligibleAssigneesQuery{assignmentId, search} -> active tenant users holding that role (direct or via group), for the searchable user dropdowns (PRD 10.4); pricing-approver eligibility variant filters by PermissionCatalog.Pricing.Approve

Endpoints under /api/v1/settings/business-assignments + /api/v1/settings/business-assignments/eligible-users; RequirePermission(BusinessAssignments.Manage) for writes, tenant members for eligible-user lookups

findings.description: Regression-coverage gaps (behaviors implemented and correct, just untested): no test locks the documented quote-role rule (a quote role sent with isAccountableOwner=true should 422), the duplicate-role-per-list rule, or GetEligibleAssignees with an unknown assignmentId -> 404.
findings.recommendation: Add these three negative tests to harden regression coverage. Non-blocking; can fold into T-016/T-018.

findings.description: Role-active state is not re-checked when enumerating holders. If a role is deactivated AFTER being configured, GetBusinessAssignments still returns it and GetUsersHoldingRoleAsync still lists its holders, whereas EffectivePermissionResolver would stop conferring that role's permissions. Internally consistent (config + picker agree) and the assignment concept differs from permission resolution, so not a true parity bug.
findings.evidence: BusinessAssignmentStore.cs:135-140 (Roles join without IsActive filter); EligibleAssigneeReader.cs:28-40.
findings.recommendation: A later task may want config reads to flag/exclude now-inactive roles. Product note, not a fix here.

findings.description: EligibleAssigneeReader search wraps user input in %...% without escaping LIKE metacharacters (%/_); a search containing % matches broadly. Functional nuance only; parameterization keeps it injection-safe.
findings.recommendation: Escape LIKE metacharacters in the search term if exact-substring semantics are desired. Non-blocking.

ASSIGNMENT_ROLE_IN_USE guard: HasLiveAssignmentsAsync probes to_regclass('lead_assignments')/('quote_assignments'); returns false (safe no-op, matches current test behavior) while neither table exists, and throws NotSupportedException (rather than guessing true/false) if a future migration creates one before this method is extended — flagged for T-018/T-020 to implement the real predicate once their FK/column contract is defined. Flagged ambiguity: spec FR-23/PRD 8 do not say whether quote-target roles need their own accountable owner; validator requires quote roles to carry IsAccountableOwner=false (accountable owner treated as lead-only), documented in UpdateBusinessAssignmentsValidator's remarks for revisiting if a later task clarifies otherwise. Playwright: added a 'settings > business assignments' block to e2e_tests/tests/settings.spec.ts marked test.fixme (Settings UI is T-016, not yet built), following the same precedent as the existing reference-data/business-rules blocks in that file; backend contract proven by the API integration tests instead. Liquibase changeset verified applying and idempotent against the live docker-compose Postgres (docker compose run --rm liquibase, twice).

Evaluation (iteration 1/10): VERDICT PASS. All five gates met, no critical/high/major findings. Independent suite (clean first run, no flakes): Domain 9/9, Infrastructure 45/45, Api 150/150 = 204/204. Independent Liquibase double-apply on throwaway postgres:17 + liquibase:4.29: first 24 changesets Run, second 0 (idempotent); \d business_assignments confirms LIST partition by tenant_id, PK (tenant_id,id), identity bigint (no UUID), unique(tenant_id,role_id,applies_to), check applies_to IN (lead,quote), default partition present; no FK to roles (intentional, matches user_roles/group_roles non-FK pattern vs global roles table), no JSONB, no EF migrations. create_tenant_partitions registers business_assignments (runOnChange, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS). COMPLETENESS: GET shape correct, exactly-one-lead-accountable-owner (both zero and two tested), role refs validated active + tenant-or-global-visible, transactional full replace, audit before/after asserted; gates GET->View, PUT->Manage, eligible lookups->tenant membership. ELIGIBLE-ASSIGNEE PARITY: faithful one-for-one mirror of EffectivePermissionResolver's four grant paths, inverted to enumerate holders, tenant-scoped + member-confined (stricter, correct for a picker); no missed path. DEFERRED IN-USE GUARD: sound - to_regclass no-op while both tables absent, throws NotSupportedException if exactly one appears (prevents silently-wrong answer), documented at interface/handler/store, no-op removal tested. QUOTE-ROLE ACCOUNTABLE-OWNER=false: spec-consistent (AC-022 scopes accountable owner to lead role), documented. ELIGIBLE-USER ACCESS MODEL (tenant-membership only): intended - feeds RM Assign dialog + approver picker, not a settings-admin action; discloses only in-tenant colleague name/email/role; IDOR-safe (assignmentId resolved against tenant's own config -> NOT_FOUND for foreign id). SECURITY: authz correct, tenant isolation via explicit TenantId predicates (F-020 lesson) + isolation/cross-tenant 403 tests, parameterized SQL incl. to_regclass(@tableName), audit satisfies NFR-02, backend-only no XSS surface. Non-blocking findings F-039 (minor test gaps: quote-role-true 422, duplicate-role, unknown-assignmentId 404), F-040 (info: role-active not re-checked on holder enumeration - internally consistent, product note), F-041 (info: search LIKE metacharacters unescaped, injection-safe). Recommend PASS.
